explanation: Provides exact selected-bank address bounds without including absolute pointers in a numeric growth envelope. Both pointer cells and both full stage-family extents are bounded, which is needed when later calls preserve the occupied prefix.
theorem_title: Both selected source-stage families lie inside their bank
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankSources.source_bounds {base NB NC g h J cut i s : ℕ}
    (hi : i < _root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandPairSlices.count NB NC g)
    (hs : s < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightBlockSourceCatalog.count h J) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankSources.leftCell base h J cut i s < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish base NB NC g h J cut ∧
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankSources.rightCell base h J cut i s < _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish base NB NC g h J cut ∧
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankSources.leftBase base h J cut i s+(J*(464*h)+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) cut ≤
      _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish base NB NC g h J cut ∧
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankSources.rightBase base h J cut i s+(J*(464*h)+1)*_root_.ThreeSum.SubsetAddress.downsetCap (J*(464*h)) cut ≤
      _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandBankData.finish base NB NC g h J cut := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $b,N_B,N_C,g,h,J,c,i,s\in\mathbb N$ be the bank base, original source sizes, band width, local parameters, source cutoff, band index, and occurrence index. Assume $i$ is below the common-band slice count and $s$ below the occurrence-bank count. Both stage-pointer cells are strictly before the bank finish; each selected left and right stage family, of extent $(464hJ+1)D(464hJ,c)$, ends at or before that finish, where $D$ is the compact downset capacity.

Provides exact selected-bank address bounds without including absolute pointers in a numeric growth envelope. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
